summary: ClearOne, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement — a Loan Agreement with First Finance Ltd. for up to $1,000,000 in tranches ($500,000 initial, $250,000 per additional tranche), bearing 11% annual interest, maturing December 30, 2026 (or earlier by mutual agreement). Prepayment is permitted without penalty. Proceeds are for general working capital. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
